svg.title: Cookie sesi browser
svg.metadata: {"authoring":"native-vector","brief":"Original editorial doodle for Buatin, a service turning website briefs into planning documents. Controlled hand-drawn rounded ink lines, slight irregularity, simple shapes, generous negative space. Forest green #235C46, ink #202B27, sage #E4EEE7, restrained yellow #F3D37A. Transparent background. No written words, gradients, 3D, heavy shadows, watermarks, stock characters, or certification badges. Match this asset family's geometry. A browser frame with a few small rounded data tiles. One tile sits beside the frame to suggest a remembered session. A clear editorial metaphor with little detail."}
